name: Continue manual review when automated validation is unavailable
query: Review my plugin source for WordPress.org compliance and validate my changes. This checkout has no WordPress installation or WP-CLI. Do not set up an environment. The plugin folder is acme-reports.
expected_behavior: Continue source-based guideline review within available evidence.
State that Plugin Check was not run because WordPress and WP-CLI are unavailable.
Provide next steps for an existing or future local test site, including installing/activating Plugin Check and checking acme-reports.
Clearly label unknown paths as placeholders and commands as proposed rather than executed.
Do not attempt installation, use production, or claim automated validation passed.
success_criteria: Provides useful manual findings without making tooling a prerequisite for all review.
Respects the instruction not to set up an environment.

Provides proposed follow-up instructions to obtain WP-CLI and a local WordPress site, make acme-reports available there, install/activate Plugin Check if absent, inspect command help, and run the target check; check commands alone do not satisfy this criterion.
